correctness.rationale: Equation (1) follows exactly from the binomial theorem and partitions matrix entries by cycle residues. Every coefficient is nonnegative for \(0\le h\le1\). For \(n\ge p\) a unique penultimate-power coefficient is strictly negative beyond one. Short-cycle coefficients reduce to explicit cubics and a strictly decreasing quartic with exactly one positive crossing. The 2-state spectral implication is proved for every nonnegative pair of transition rates, including reducible chains, using a nonnegative stationary projection and Taylor remainder. Exact rational calculations certify the three-state negative diagonal -1/128 with nonstationary spectral radius 79/128. A standalone rational-matrix verifier passed 4,070 check groups; the proof, not finite enumeration, supports infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The exact classifications solve a natural complete family of finite-state Markov master-equation time steps for four classical exponential Taylor orders, and expose the nonmonotone dependence of the admissible timestep on cycle length. The three-state rational example is a minimal-dimensional obstruction showing that spectral damping and preservation of nonnegative probabilities are separate numerical safety criteria. It is a practical benchmark for choosing time steps and diagnosing otherwise invisible probability violations; these facts are not merely a substituted generic SSP formula.
